subject.entry_points_source: README.md, API Docs: scramp.ScramClient has set_server_first(message), 'Set the first message from the server.', and set_server_final(message), 'Set the final message from the server.' (lines 658 and 660); scramp.ScramServer has set_client_first(message), 'Set the first message from the client.', and set_client_final(message), 'Set the final client message.' (lines 723 and 725). The examples end 'If it all runs through without raising an exception, the authentication has succeeded' (lines 128-129). Entry points are names, so the same names elsewhere in the package count too.
